reason: 该插件的主要面向点为界面增强：仓库说明、目录结构与功能列表均围绕皮肤定制、壁纸/背景、浮动控制面板、播放器与可视化等展示与交互体验展开，并将配置持久化到本地路径及提供看图、表情与人设注入等聊天面板扩展，属于用户可见的 UI/主题定制插件。

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness Web 的界面增强插件，提供主题、壁纸、播放器、声浪展示、表情与截图识别等可视化和聊天辅助功能，并支持本地持久化设置。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness web UI plugin that enhances the interface with themes, wallpaper, music/player visuals, emoji tools, and screenshot-to-message helpers, with local persistent settings for customization.

capabilities: Theme and layout customization for the DSH web UI
Background/animated wallpaper and media asset handling
Embedded music playback with basic controls
Screenshot-to-message workflow for local vision model
Agent prompt/tool hooks for persona and emoji usage
